native_notify_alert_copy_details: Button of the native error dialog (Linux) that copies the diagnostics report to the clipboard.
native_notify_alert_crashed: First paragraph of the native error dialog (Linux) when the web process crashed twice within a short time.
native_notify_alert_details: Rest of the native error dialog: the two log files and the page to report it on. {stderr} and {app} are file paths, {url} the issue page.
native_notify_alert_ended: First paragraph of the native error dialog (Linux) when the web process ended for another reason twice within a short time.
native_notify_alert_not_ready: First paragraph of the native error dialog when the page never reported it was ready. {secs} is the wait.
native_notify_alert_out_of_memory: First paragraph of the native error dialog (Linux) when the web process ran out of memory twice within a short time.
native_notify_alert_quit: Button of the native error dialog that quits Atlas.
native_notify_alert_reopen: Button of the native error dialog that reloads the window.
native_notify_alert_terminated: First paragraph of the native error dialog (Linux) when the app itself ended the web process twice within a short time.
native_notify_alert_title: Title of the native error dialog shown when the page of the main window never started or its web process keeps dying.
native_notify_capture_failed: Title of the system notification shown when a screenshot or recording could not be made; the body says why.
native_notify_dock_agent_gone: Error the agent dock shows when the agent it was about to send text to has gone away.
native_notify_dock_keys_clash: Error under the agent dock's key settings when both shortcuts are the same.
native_notify_dock_not_built: Error returned to the page when it asks for the dock's right-click menu and the dock window does not exist.
native_notify_no_home: Error under the shell setting when Atlas cannot find the user's home folder to save the choice in.

native_notify_no_permission.description: Body of the notification, and error on the capture card, when macOS has not granted Screen Recording to Atlas. The panel names are the ones of macOS.

native_notify_shell_not_executable: Error under the shell setting when the chosen file cannot be run. {path} is what the person typed.
